positive_pair: same original label, different sequence groups, other sample; within same random minibatch
negative_pair: opposite original label, different sequence groups, same minibatch
anchor_rule: requires >=1 positive and >=1 negative; singleton or excluded samples skipped; zero term if no eligible anchors
flags: supcon_all includes all; supcon_unflagged excludes flagged from contrastive anchors and partners only, retains all for BCE; unflagged not gold
fusion: single 1D + fixed historical 3D; conditional not full 3seed
contrastive: normalized pooled BiMamba representation; no extra projector
selection: fixed lambda and temperature, minimum unweighted validation BCE, patience2; no outer fold tuning
biological_claim: no claim of biological mechanism, no hard mining, no sample weighting
